options.name: access_token
options.description: The token to access FortiManager without using username and password.

options.name: bypass_validation
options.description: Only set to True when module schema diffs with FortiAnalyzer API structure, module continues to execute without validating parameters

options.name: forticloud_access_token
options.description: Authenticate Ansible client with forticloud API access token.

options.name: log_path
options.description: The path to save log. Used if enable_log is true. Please use absolute path instead of relative path. If the log_path setting is incorrect, the log will be saved in /tmp/fortianalyzer.ansible.log

options.name: proposed_method
options.description: The overridden method for the underlying Json RPC request

options.name: rc_failed
options.description: the rc codes list with which the conditions to fail will be overriden

options.name: rc_succeeded
options.description: the rc codes list with which the conditions to succeed will be overriden

options.name: state
options.description: The directive to create, update or delete an object

options.name: version_check
options.description: If set to True, it will check whether the parameters used are supported by the corresponding version of FortiAnazlyer locally based on FNDN data. A warning will be returned in version_check_warning if there is a mismatch. This warning is only a suggestion and may not be accurate.
